signIn.title: Welcome back
signIn.subtitle: Sign in to your household.
signIn.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
signIn.passkeysUnavailable: This account needs a passkey, but this server cannot check passkeys yet. Ask the instance admin.
signIn.passkeySubtitle: Your account is protected by a passkey too.
signIn.passkeyNotUsed: Your passkey was not used. Try again, or go back to your password.
signIn.passkeyRefused: That passkey did not work. Sign in again with your password and a passkey of this account.

conversationMenu.label: Options for {{title}}
conversationMenu.deleteBody: Its messages are deleted for good. Files in your workspace stay.

questions.title: The assistant asks
questions.ownWords: Or answer in your own words

temporary.hint: This chat won't be in your list or your search, and it's deleted when you leave it.
temporary.notice: Temporary chat: not in your list, and deleted when you leave it.

composer.label: Message
composer.local: Runs on your home server. Nothing leaves the household.
composer.remote: Messages go to {{connection}} and the provider that runs the model.
composer.chatOnly: This model can only chat: it cannot search, read or write files, or run commands.
composer.noModel: No model is set up yet. A household admin can add one in Settings.
composer.refused: This chat's model runs remotely, and only local models are allowed. Choose a local model to continue.

picker.title: Choose a model
picker.footer: Prices are per million tokens. OpenRouter lists its most used models first.
picker.refused: Not available: only local models are allowed.

message.editHint: Sending deletes the messages after this one.

page.title: Activity
page.hint: Every tool call your assistant made for you, and whether it needed your approval. What the calls sent and received stays in the chats.

rewind.title: Send the edited message?
rewind.bodyOne: The {{count}} message after it will be deleted. This can't be undone.
rewind.bodyMany: The {{count}} messages after it will be deleted. This can't be undone.
rewind.files: Files in your workspace stay as they are.

settings.title: Settings
settings.householdNote: These settings apply to every user of the household. Only its admins see them.
settings.defaultHint: New conversations start with this model, unless a user chose a default of their own. Anyone in the household can switch models in a conversation.
settings.voiceHint: Which models turn spoken turns into text and read answers aloud. Without them, voice is off.
settings.voicePlaceholder: The voice's name, such as alloy
settings.connectionsHint: Each connection brings all of its models.
settings.servedWindow: The server runs {{model}} with a context window of {{served}} tokens, smaller than this connection's {{configured}}, so long conversations are compacted sooner and some requests can't fit.
settings.servedWindowFix: To give it {{configured}} tokens, set OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH={{configured}} on the Ollama server and restart it, or lower this connection's context window to match.
settings.removeBody: Its models leave the model list. Conversations that use one of them stop until someone chooses another model.
settings.themeHint: Follow the device, or always use one theme.

connection.title: Add a connection
connection.name: Name
connection.addressHint: Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM or LM Studio, such as http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1. Addresses on your network work only for the server's administrator.
connection.apiKeyHint: Create one at openrouter.ai, under Keys. Every OpenRouter model becomes available to the household, most used first.
connection.connectedBodyOne: {{count}} model is now in the model list.
connection.connectedBodyMany: {{count}} models are now in the model list.

reasons.timeout: The server did not answer in time
reasons.tls_untrusted: The server's certificate is not trusted
reasons.http_error: The server answered with an error
reasons.not_a_model_server: The address answers, but it is not a model server

fixes.name_not_found: This server can't find that name. Use the machine's IP address, or give it a fixed name in your router.
fixes.connection_refused: The machine answers, but no program listens on that port. Check that the model server runs and listens on the network: Ollama listens only on 127.0.0.1 unless OLLAMA_HOST is set to 0.0.0.0.
fixes.timeout: The machine may be off or asleep, or a firewall drops the connection. Check that this server can reach it.
fixes.tls_untrusted: On your home network, use http:// instead, or give the server a certificate from a trusted authority.
fixes.address_not_allowed: Only public https addresses are allowed, unless the server's administrator sets the address: requests leave from the server and must not reach your home network.
fixes.http_error: Check the address: most servers expect /v1 at the end, such as http://192.168.1.10:11434/v1.
fixes.unauthorized: Copy the key again. For OpenRouter, keys start with sk-or-, and a deleted or disabled key stops working.
fixes.not_a_model_server: Check the address: it reaches something else, such as a router's page.

connection.editDescription: Change this connection. A new address or key is tested before it is saved.
connection.keepKeyHint: Leave it empty to keep the current key.
connection.contextWindowHint: The most tokens a model of this server reads at once. On Ollama, it is set by OLLAMA_CONTEXT_LENGTH.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.model_unavailable: The conversation's model can't be used. Choose another model in the message box, or ask a household admin to check its connection in Settings.
errors.model_request_failed: The model refused the request or failed to answer. Try again, or choose another model in the message box.
errors.model_refused: The model declined to answer this request. Rephrase your message, or choose another model in the message box. It said:
errors.sandbox_unavailable: Your workspace could not be started. Try again in a minute; if it keeps failing, tell the server's administrator.
errors.run_worker_lost: The answer was interrupted when the server restarted. Send your message again.
errors.run_timeout: The answer took too long and was stopped. Try a shorter request.
errors.internal_error: The server could not finish the answer. Try again; if it keeps failing, tell the server's administrator.
errors.network: The server can't be reached. Check your connection and try again.
errors.model_egress_refused: This chat's model runs remotely, and only local models are allowed, so nothing was sent. Choose a local model in the message box.
errors.model_tool_misuse: The model kept using one of its tools the wrong way, so it couldn't go on. Try again, or choose another model in the message box.
errors.model_context_exceeded: The model ran out of room before it could answer: the conversation no longer fits in its context window. Start a new conversation, choose another model, or ask a household admin to give the model's server a larger context window (for Ollama, num_ctx).
errors.run_step_limit: The assistant stopped after many steps, before it was done. Ask it to continue, and it goes on from where it stopped.

files.diagramFailed: This diagram could not be drawn. Its source shows what is wrong.
files.title: Files
files.deleteBody: {{name}} will be deleted from the workspace. This can't be undone.
files.deleteFolderBody: The folder {{name}} and everything in it will be deleted from the workspace. This can't be undone.
files.resetBody: Every file of this conversation's workspace will be deleted, uploads included. The conversation itself stays. This can't be undone.
files.empty: Nothing here yet. Attach a file to a message, or ask the assistant to make one.
files.noPreview: No preview for this kind of file. Download it to open it.
files.linkPreview: A link: it is never followed. It can be deleted.

errors.resource_conflict: Something with that name is already there.
errors.sandbox_unavailable: The workspace can't be reached now. Try again in a minute.

assistant.title: Assistant
assistant.hint: How your new conversations start. Each conversation can change these in its own settings.
assistant.modelHint: For your new chats, it overrides the household's default model, which applies while you choose none.
assistant.noHouseholdModel: The household has no default model
assistant.reasoningHint: How much the model thinks before it answers. Deep is slower, and costs more on paid models.
assistant.toolsHint: What the assistant may use. A tool that is off is not offered to the model.

toolNames.start_command: Start a command in the background

assistant.additionalHint: Added after the system prompt, for example how you like answers.
assistant.dangerHint: Replacing the system prompt changes who the assistant is, and can make its answers worse.
assistant.baseHint: What the model is told before the conversation. What it needs to use its tools is added after it, whatever you write.
assistant.chatHint: For this conversation, from its next answer.

voice.noMicrophone: The microphone is not available. Allow it in the browser's settings.
voice.notHeard: Your words could not be transcribed. Try again.
voice.hint: Tap the button, or press your headset's or car's next-track button, to start talking and again when you are done. After each answer, it listens again by itself.

states.listening: Listening. Tap when you are done
states.failed: Something went wrong. Tap to try again

said.code: There is a code block in the conversation.
said.table: There is a table in the conversation.
said.image: There is an image in the conversation.
said.diagram: There is a diagram in the conversation.

voice.capturing: Your voice, as it is captured

errors.unplayable: The audio the speech model sent could not be played.
errors.microphone: The microphone is not available. Allow it in the browser's settings.
errors.notRead: The answer could not be read aloud

voice.refused: Voice uses a remote model, and only local models are allowed.

approvals.title: Approval needed
approvals.deniedInHours: Denied in {{count}} hours unless you answer.
approvals.deniedInMinutes: Denied in {{count}} minutes unless you answer.

reasons.untrusted_content: The assistant has read content from elsewhere in this chat, such as web pages or command output, which could be trying to steer it into sending your data out. Check that this is what you asked for.
reasons.tool_default: This tool always asks before it runs.
reasons.permission: Your household's admin asked that this tool ask you before it runs.
reasons.consequential: This can't be undone, or acts in the real world, so it asks every time.
reasons.device: Calls to your devices and connected services always ask.

outcomes.refused: Turned off by your household's admin

approvals.allowedHint: What you allowed when the assistant asked. Withdraw it and it asks again.

permissions.title: Tool permissions
permissions.hint: What each user's assistant may use. Ask makes every call wait for their approval; Deny takes the tool away. Tools still ask when a chat has content from elsewhere.
permissions.byClassHint: A setting for a tool wins over these; among these, the strictest wins.
permissions.lockedByAdmin: Turned off by your household's admin

egress.title: Local models only
egress.hint: Local models run on the household's own hardware: your messages never leave the house. Remote models run at a provider.
egress.ownHint: Remote models become unavailable for you, voice included when it runs remotely.
egress.byHousehold: Your household uses only local models.
egress.byAdmin: Your household's admin chose only local models for you.
egress.householdHint: When on, nobody in the household can use remote models: their messages never leave the house.
egress.forUserHint: This user can't use remote models. They can't turn it off; they can choose it themselves.

passkeys.title: Passkeys
passkeys.hint: A passkey makes signing in need your device too, unlocked with your fingerprint, face or PIN, on top of your password. Add one on each device you use, so that losing one never locks you out.
passkeys.unavailable: Passkeys are not available on this server yet. The instance admin can enable them by setting the address people use to open Sibillo.
passkeys.addHint: Give it a name you will recognize, such as the device it is on. Your password confirms that it is you.
passkeys.name: Name
passkeys.notMade: Your device did not make a passkey. Try again.
passkeys.rejected: The passkey could not be added. Try again.
passkeys.removeHint: Your password confirms that it is you. Without passkeys, your password alone signs you in.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.hint: When an answer is ready, or the assistant needs your approval or an answer while you are away, this device can tell you. A notification never shows what the conversation says.
notifications.privacy: They go through your browser's push service, which learns when Sibillo notifies this device, never what about.
notifications.blocked: This browser blocks notifications from Sibillo. Allow them in the browser's site settings, then turn them on here.
notifications.unavailable: Notifications are not available on this server yet. The instance admin can enable them by setting the address people use to open Sibillo.
notifications.unsupported: This browser can't receive notifications. On an iPhone or iPad, add Sibillo to the Home Screen and open it from there.
notifications.denied: The browser did not allow notifications. You can allow them in its site settings.
notifications.failed: Notifications could not be changed on this device. Try again.

run_failed.title: An answer could not be finished
run_failed.body: Open Sibillo to see what happened.

approval_pending.title: The assistant needs your approval
approval_pending.body: It is waiting for you before it goes on.

question_pending.title: The assistant has a question
question_pending.body: It is waiting for your answer before it goes on.

members.title: Members
members.hint: The people of the household. A member who lost the device with their passkey can sign in again once you remove their passkeys.
members.removeBody: {{username}} will then sign in with their password alone, until they add a passkey again. Their open sessions stay signed in.

memory.title: Memory
memory.hint: What the assistant remembers about you, given to every chat but temporary ones. It is all there is: nothing else is kept. Change or delete anything here.
memory.on: The assistant remembers what matters and uses it in your chats.
memory.off: Memory is off: the assistant neither uses nor adds to it. What is here stays until you delete it.
memory.itemHint: One fact about you, in a short sentence. The assistant uses it from your next message.
memory.confirmHint: The assistant wrote this after reading content that was not yours. Check it. Saving it confirms it, and the assistant then trusts it.
memory.deleteAllBody: Every item will be deleted for good, {{count}} in all. This cannot be undone.
memory.untrustedHint: Written after the assistant read content that was not yours, such as a web page: it may be wrong, or planted. Until you save it, the assistant treats it with caution.
memory.full: Memory is full: it holds at most 10,000 characters. Shorten or delete other items first.

skills.title: Skills
skills.hint: Instructions and files the assistant uses when they fit the task. Every chat sees each skill's name and description; the rest is read only when needed.
skills.none: No skills of your own yet. Create one, upload one, import one, or ask the assistant to make one.
skills.newHint: Write the skill's SKILL.md: its name and description at the top, then what to do.
skills.editHint: Changes apply from the next answer. Editing a skill does not make it trusted.
skills.builtinHint: A built-in skill comes with Sibillo and cannot be changed; turn it off if you don't want it.
skills.deleteBody: The skill and its files are deleted; this cannot be undone. Chats already held keep what they said.
skills.trustHint: Read every file before you trust this skill. Once trusted, using it no longer makes the assistant ask before it searches or runs commands.
skills.untrustedHint: someone other than you wrote it, so using it in a chat makes the assistant ask before it searches the web or runs commands.
skills.savedInDeletedChat: Saved by the assistant in a deleted chat
skills.importHint: A GitHub repository, as owner/repo or its address, a folder of one, or the address of a .zip or .skill file. It is downloaded in a sandbox.
skills.choose: It holds several skills. Choose the ones to import:
skills.nameTaken: Another skill already has this name.
skills.invalid: This is not a valid skill.
skills.chatHint: The skills this chat may use. A skill you add later is on here too.

admin.title: MCP servers
admin.hint: Services the assistant can use through the Model Context Protocol, such as Home Assistant or GitHub. You choose which of each server's tools the household may use; the assistant asks before every call. People who need an account connect their own.
admin.addHint: Its address speaks Streamable HTTP. You review its tools after adding it.
admin.name: Name
admin.prefixHint: Lowercase letters, digits and single underscores, such as home. The model sees its tools as prefix__tool. It cannot be changed later.
admin.addressHint: Such as https://api.example.com/mcp, or http://homeassistant.local:8123/api/mcp on the household's network.

authHints.token: Each person enters a token of their own, created at the service.
authHints.oauth: Each person signs in to the service with their own account.

admin.clientIdHint: Usually leave it empty: the service reads Sibillo's own description, as Home Assistant does, or Sibillo registers itself. Some services, such as GitHub, need an OAuth app created there, with this site's address followed by /mcp-sign-in as its callback.
admin.notAdded: The server could not be added.
admin.taken: A server with this name or prefix already exists, or the household has 20 servers.
admin.connectToList: Connect your own account under Services to list its tools.
admin.notRefreshed: The tools could not be listed
admin.removeBody: Its tools leave every conversation, and everyone's account connections to it are forgotten.

review.title: Tools of {{name}}
review.hint: Accept only the tools whose description you are happy for the assistant to read: the model reads every word of it. A tool that changes is not used until you accept it again.
review.noTools: The server lists no tools yet.
review.hints: Hints from the server, which grant nothing:
review.goneHint: The server no longer lists this tool.
review.listedAgain: The server's tools changed since you saw them: look at them again.

problems.name: Its name is too long or has characters a model can't use.
problems.description_too_long: Its description is longer than 4,000 characters.
problems.schema_too_large: Its input is described in more than 16 KB.
problems.too_many_tools: The server lists more than 100 tools.
problems.requires_tasks: It works only as a background task, which Sibillo does not support.

services.title: Services
services.hint: Services your household connected the assistant to. For those that need an account, connect your own: nobody else uses it, and the assistant asks you before every call.
services.none: Your household has connected no service yet.
services.leastRights: Give the token the least rights it needs, such as read-only access, or access to some repositories only.
services.revokeHint: Sibillo forgets your sign-in; the service may still list Sibillo among your connected apps, where you can remove it.

switches.title: Services
switches.hint: Each service connected by your household, with the tools its admin accepted. The assistant asks before every call to one.
switches.notConnected: Your account is not connected: connect it in Settings, under Services.

permissions.title: Services
permissions.hint: Deny a service to take all of its tools away from this user.
